in_marathi.name: Nikitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victorious in battle
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nikitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nikitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'niki' which means victory. This name is often given to a girl born into a warrior or royal family in Hindu tradition, symbolizing her destiny to win battles and rule her kingdom with courage and wisdom.
